# Legacy observations: T4 rectangle and vector clips (local probe, 2026-10-05)

Captured by the `legacy_clip_capture` probe ([`clip_capture.cpp`](../../../../tools/legacy-capture/clip_capture.cpp), target in [`tools/legacy-capture/CMakeLists.txt`](../../../../tools/legacy-capture/CMakeLists.txt)) on the cases in [`inputs/clip-cases.txt`](../../../../tools/legacy-capture/inputs/clip-cases.txt). The probe compiles the legacy `HikariSub/VisualClipRect.cpp` and `HikariSub/VisualClips.cpp` at `20d647c4` unchanged, with the real `VisualClipPoint.h`, and copies these out of their files unchanged ([`extract_functions.py`](../../../../tools/legacy-capture/extract_functions.py)): the classes `Visuals`, `ClipRect` (Visuals.h), `DrawingAndClip` (VisualClips.h), `FindData` and `TagFindReplace` (TagFindReplace.h); Visuals' constructor, destructor, `RenderSubs`, both `SetVisual`s, `SizeChanged`, `CalcMovePos`, `GetVectorPoints`, `GetPosnScale`, `SetModified`, `RotateDrawing` and `CalcDrawingSize` (Visuals.cpp); `TagFindReplace::FindTag`, `Replace`, `GetDouble`, `GetTwoValueDouble`, `GetTextResult`, `GetPositionInText` and `FindBrackets` (TagFindReplace.cpp); `EditBox::GetEditor` and `IsCursorOnStart` (EditBox.cpp); `getfloat` and `FindFromEnd` (config.cpp). They run against stand-ins ([`tools/legacy-capture/clip/`](../../../../tools/legacy-capture/clip)): the Line editor (its text and caret, `SetTextS` as DialogueTextEditor.cpp:135-155 sets them), the Grid's Lines and selection, `EditBox::Send` reduced to its text columns, `SubsGrid::SetModified` with its consequences (redit reloads the Line editor; an edit that is not a visual's dummy resets the tool, as ShowEditOnVideo's SetVisual does, dropping the cached Line text of the dummy renders as RendererVideo.cpp:1110 does, stopped after three nested resets), the video toolbar's `VectorItem::SetItemToggled`, and a record of the bell and the message box. The drawing (`DrawRect`, `DrawCircle`, `DrawDashedLine`, `Draw`) is not run; `GetDialogueAdditionalPosition` and `GetMoveTimes`, which only the other tools' placement reads, are stubbed.

Built locally with GCC 16.2.1 and the distribution's wxWidgets 3.2.11 (wxGTK, `wx-config --cxxflags base,core`). Run:

```
cmake -S tools/legacy-capture -B <dir> -DLEGACY_SOURCE=<checkout at 20d647c4> -DWX_CONFIG=$(which wx-config)
cmake --build <dir> --target legacy_clip_capture
<dir>/legacy_clip_capture < tools/legacy-capture/inputs/clip-cases.txt > observations.jsonl
```

`observations.jsonl` holds one line per `dump` (100, in 43 cases): every Line's text and translation (what the Grid holds: committed), the Line editor's text, the history entries and how many changed a text (`steps`), the tool's resets and whether they recursed, the bell and message box count; for the rectangle clip its corners, shown and inverse flags and grabbed handle; for the vector clip every point (x, y, command, start, selected), `GetVisual`'s text (the body written), the mask's raw Line (layer and text), the clip scale (`vectorScale`), the mode, the grabbed point, the coefficients and whether a selection box is drawn. sha256 `9da386e0dafc70a41674dc93190a567eadb9f46032d33dc1b2b3ee33b7ff2764`.

The cases: a rectangle drawn on a Line without a clip; one read with fractional numbers between other tags; its left edge, a corner and the whole rectangle dragged, and clamped at the video's edges; \\iclip read and Invert clip (with a vector clip in the Line); the A/D/W/S keys with Shift, Alt alone, Ctrl and Alt+Shift; a rectangle without width; new clips in a Line with a block and no clip, without a block and empty; a clip in the second block with the caret there and at the start; three Lines selected (a drag, then Invert clip); a zoom; a pillarbox; TLMode. Vector clips: lines drawn from nothing; a Bézier and B-spline points added; integer and fractional coordinates (rounded half to even, "-0"); two subpaths; malformed commands (an unknown letter, a lone number, words); an incomplete Bézier; no "m"; two "m"s in a row; "p" and "c" in a B-spline; doubled blanks, a comma and a tab (a comma makes the text before it read as a clip scale); a clip scale with a comma, with a blank, and kept on a Line without one; \\iclip's mask; a selection box, the keys and Delete; Ctrl+click, Shift and Alt drags; removing Bézier, B-spline and "m" points with the middle button and the Delete mode; removing the last point, in the Delete mode and in Add B-spline after Ctrl+A (the release then swallowed), then a new point; right clicks inserting after a point and refused inside a Bézier; a separate point and the "Double m" refusal; the wheel; Invert clip over three Lines; a drag, Invert clip and a point added (the clip stays \\iclip); the wheel left on the Invert clip button; three Lines selected; TLMode; a zoom.

## Compared with the rewrite

`ClipCapture.ReplaysTheLegacyProbe` (`hikari_application_visual_clip_tests`) sets every case up through `visual::VideoView` (and checks it gives the video rectangle and zoom the probe ran with), replays it through `visual::RectangleClipTool` and `visual::VectorClipTool` with a key's release after each press, and compares every dump: the committed texts, the Line editor's text during a gesture on one Line (the staged text), the steps that changed a text and the last one's name, the bell and notices, the corners and flags, every point and its selection, the body, clip scale, mode, selection box, coefficients and the mask Line, float for float. Where the rewrite's rules differ the test checks its own outcome instead:

- Proposed T4-clip-read-start (`rect-second-block-caret`): legacy's ClipRect read the clip from the Line editor's caret (FindTag mode 0, VisualClipRect.cpp:229), so with the caret in the second block it found the clip there; the tools read from the start (as legacy did with the caret at the start, `rect-second-block-start`, which matches).
- Proposed T4-zero-rect-preview (`rect-zero-width`): a rectangle released without width left its preview in legacy's Line editor, unsent (VisualClipRect.cpp:129-147); the rewrite drops it.
- Proposed T4-wheel-invert-slot (`vector-wheel-to-invert`): with the wheel left on the Invert clip button (mode 6), legacy's ChangeTool inverted the clip on every reset (VisualClips.cpp:1499-1504), and the inversion's SetModified reset the tool again: the probe stopped the recursion after three levels (legacy recursed until the stack overflowed). The rewrite inverts only on the button.

Legacy behaviour the capture shows, kept: the rectangle clip is written with the corners truncated and ordered and replaces the first clip found from the start whatever its kind (a vector clip included); a clip read with three commas but not four numbers keeps the previous state; \\iclip stays inverse on a Line without a clip; Invert clip names every clip of the kind in the targets after the active Line's last one, and is recorded as the vector clip's edit for the rectangle too; the vector clip keeps \\clip or \\iclip, writes integers (printf rounding), a lone "m" with an "l" to itself, and keeps a clip scale on a Line without one; a comma anywhere in a vector clip makes what precedes it the scale; a number left over before a command letter pairs with the next; the first point is drawn and written as "m"; removing the last point sends the clip's removal at once, on the press or the key (`vector-remove-all`, dump 1: SetClip's empty-clip branch, VisualClips.cpp:444-455), and in the add modes the hover block then swallows the release (VisualClips.cpp:906-907); legacy recorded a history step on every release, changed or not (the rewrite records only changes).
